title: Clarissa Littler - (roughly) a hundred days of poetry in partnership
speaker: Clarissa Littler
talk_title: (roughly) a hundred days of poetry in partnership
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Clarissa is an ex-physicist, ex-computer scientist working on phenomenology and the computational humanities when they're not teaching games programming to youth. They discusses their project of writing poetry in conjunction with a poetry form generator, how getting better at poetry and improving the generator go hand in hand, and leads into bigger musings about procgen as a tool for tying computation into the humanities and helping us think about what makes an art form.

Find them on Twitter: https://twitter.com/clarissaAdjoint
